title: 逆向提示词反推
type: 图片反推元提示词→去身份JSON→两种角色同模板生图

test_input.style_ref: W014照片，抽象世界观不固化男性外貌
test_input.语言判断: 英文仅推测，不声称可从图片证明原语言

adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，不冒充原指定模型实测
changes: 先执行反推并存去身份JSON，再用完整引导词的角色/场景分工生成控制与替换两图。
与角色相关描述从外部素材解析，JSON不包含独特发型五官。
原语言不可由像素确定，字段明确标推测；不把反推描述当成找回真实原提示词。

meta_output.composition: wide horizontal photograph, full body on left third, large television on right half, eye-level natural perspective
meta_output.background_type: photorealistic contemporary lakeside living room, medium to rich detail, environment supports restful emotion
meta_output.background_style: warm wooden cabinet and floor, neutral sofa, large left windows and layered distant lake hills
meta_output.space: sofa left foreground, coffee table right foreground, person midground, screen and windows behind
meta_output.screen: large purple and yellow flower image on a thin dark television
meta_output.lighting_color: warm sunset enters left window, golden lake reflection, soft amber shadows and gentle contrast
meta_output.materials: natural skin and fabric, woven throw, realistic wood grain and clear glass, restrained fine detail density
meta_output.ratio: 3:2 horizontal; preserve the supplied source crop
